note: SHA-256 of the files that tools/docker (gates.mjs, container-build.sh) and tools/portable (fwsc.mjs, page.mjs) were ported from. When one of them changes, the port may no longer do what the original does: read the change, update the port, check the result against a Windows build with tools/portable/elf-compare.mjs, then update this file. FM1_ALLOW_UNSYNCED=1 builds anyway.
